infoText.headline: Possible CO₂ costs over the next 10 years
infoText.text:
Future increases in fuel costs are possible due to CO₂ pricing. The future CO₂ price development is uncertain, therefore the possible CO₂ costs are calculated using three assumed CO₂ prices for the period 2026 to 2036.

The actual CO₂ prices can be both higher and lower than in the model calculations used here. The CO₂ costs are to be paid with the fuel costs when refuelling.

Further information at www.alternativ-mobil.info/
